ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon on-host packet capture chained to outbound tunneling (telecom lawful-intercept collection)
ucs.description: Hunts the Salt Typhoon / Earth Estries signature of staging native or dropped packet-capture tooling (pktmon, netsh trace, tcpdump/tshark, JumbledPath-style collectors) on compromised carrier/ISP infrastructure and then tunneling the captured traffic out over SSH/GRE. The capture→tunnel pairing within hours is what distinguishes this actor's traffic-interception mission from benign network troubleshooting.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("pktmon.exe","tcpdump.exe","tcpdump","tshark.exe","dumpcap.exe","windump.exe","rawcap.exe","netsh.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval is_capture=case(process_name=="pktmon.exe",1, process_name IN ("tcpdump.exe","tcpdump","tshark.exe","dumpcap.exe","windump.exe","rawcap.exe"),1, process_name=="netsh.exe" AND match(process,"(?i)trace\s+start") AND match(process,"(?i)capture=yes"),1, process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND match(process,"(?i)(New-NetEventSession|NetEventPacketCapture|pktmon)"),1, 1==1,0)
| where is_capture=1 AND NOT match(user,"\$$")
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as tunnelTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.app IN ("ssh") OR All_Traffic.dest_port IN (22,47) OR All_Traffic.transport="gre") All_Traffic.direction="outbound" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest_ip All_Traffic.dest_port
    | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
    | rename src as dest dest_ip as tunnel_remote_ip ]
| where tunnelTime>=firstTime AND tunnelTime<=(lastTime+21600)
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process tunnel_remote_ip dest_port count
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 14d;
let capture = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "pktmon.exe")
        or FileName in~ ("tcpdump.exe","tshark.exe","dumpcap.exe","windump.exe","rawcap.exe")
        or (FileName =~ "netsh.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "trace" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("capture=yes","persistent=yes"))
        or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("New-NetEventSession","NetEventPacketCapture","pktmon"))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project CaptureTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, CaptureProc = FileName, CaptureCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
capture
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("ssh.exe","plink.exe","putty.exe","ngrok.exe","frpc.exe","stunnel.exe") or RemotePort in (22, 47)
    | project TunnelTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, TunnelProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, TunnelCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
  ) on DeviceId
| where TunnelTime between (CaptureTime .. CaptureTime + 6h)   // 6h = capture-to-exfil staging window observed for this actor
| project CaptureTime, DeviceName, AccountName, CaptureProc, CaptureCmd, TunnelTime, RemoteIP, RemotePort, TunnelProc, TunnelCmd
| order by CaptureTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let lookback = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Proc = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where Proc in~ ("pktmon.exe","tcpdump.exe","tshark.exe","dumpcap.exe","windump.exe","rawcap.exe")
    or (Proc =~ "netsh.exe" and CommandLine has "trace" and CommandLine has "capture")
    or (Proc in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("New-NetEventSession","NetEventPacketCapture","pktmon"))
| where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, Proc, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Salt Typhoon On-Host Packet Capture Tooling
id: 9f1c7d2e-4b3a-4c61-8a5e-7b2c0d1e6a90
status: experimental
description: Native or dropped packet-capture utilities executed on endpoints, consistent with Salt Typhoon / Earth Estries traffic-interception tradecraft.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  capture_bin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\pktmon.exe'
      - '\tcpdump.exe'
      - '\tshark.exe'
      - '\dumpcap.exe'
      - '\windump.exe'
      - '\rawcap.exe'
  netsh_trace:
    Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'trace'
      - 'capture'
  ps_capture:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'New-NetEventSession'
      - 'NetEventPacketCapture'
      - 'pktmon'
  condition: capture_bin or netsh_trace or ps_capture
falsepositives:
  - Network engineers running scheduled diagnostics
level: medium
tags:
  - attack.collection
  - attack.t1040
  - attack.credential_access
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\pktmon.exe OR *\\Pktmon.exe OR *\\PKTMON.EXE OR *\\tcpdump.exe OR *\\tshark.exe OR *\\dumpcap.exe OR *\\windump.exe OR *\\rawcap.exe OR *\\RawCap.exe) OR (@Image:(*\\netsh.exe OR *\\Netsh.exe OR *\\NETSH.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*trace* AND *capture*)) OR (@Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*New-NetEventSession* OR *NetEventPacketCapture* OR *pktmon*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\(pktmon|tcpdump|tshark|dumpcap|windump|rawcap)\.exe$/i OR (ImageFileName=/\\netsh\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/trace/i AND CommandLine=/capture/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(New-NetEventSession|NetEventPacketCapture|pktmon)/i))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Salt Typhoon (Microsoft) — aka Earth Estries (Trend Micro), GhostEmperor (Kaspersky), FamousSparrow (ESET), UNC2286 (Mandiant) — is a Chinese state crew whose defining mission is intercepting communications at telecom/ISP carriers, including lawful-intercept portals. Their JumbledPath utility runs packet captures across chained jump hosts and exfiltrates the pcap. Random APTs run capture tools too

ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon DLL side-loading of Demodex / SparrowDoor loaders from user-writable directories
ucs.description: Hunts the GhostEmperor (Demodex rootkit loader) and FamousSparrow (SparrowDoor/Crowdoor) tradecraft of dropping a malicious DLL alongside a legitimate signed executable in a non-standard, user-writable path and side-loading it. Catches the loader stage before the kernel rootkit / backdoor is fully resident.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.dll") (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\Windows\\Temp\\*","*\\PerfLogs\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| where NOT (process_name IN ("msiexec.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","TiWorker.exe","setup.exe","OfficeClickToRun.exe"))
| where NOT match(process_name,"(?i)\$$")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest process_name file_name file_path count
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\")
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\"
    and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files\"
    and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\"
| extend DllDir = tolower(FolderPath), ProcDir = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
// loader EXE and DLL co-located in the same non-standard dir = classic side-load layout
| where ProcDir == DllDir or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, LoaderExe = InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, SideloadedDll = FileName, FolderPath, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Salt Typhoon DLL Side-Loading from User-Writable Directory
id: 2a7e91b4-6c0d-4f88-9b13-5d8e3a4c1f72
status: experimental
description: A non-system executable side-loads a DLL co-located in a user-writable directory, consistent with GhostEmperor Demodex and FamousSparrow SparrowDoor loaders.
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '.dll'
    ImageLoaded|contains:
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
  filter_legit:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\'
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Some third-party installers run helper EXEs from ProgramData
level: medium
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\ProgramData\\*.dll OR *\\Users\\Public\\*.dll OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*.dll OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\*.dll OR *\\PerfLogs\\*.dll OR *\\ProgramData\\*.DLL OR *\\Users\\Public\\*.DLL) -@Image:(C:\\Windows\\* OR C:\\Program?Files\\* OR C:\\Program?Files?\(x86\)\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\(ProgramData|Users\\Public|PerfLogs|AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|Windows\\Temp)\\.*\.dll$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/^C:\\Windows\\/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/^C:\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(msiexec|TiWorker|TrustedInstaller|OfficeClickToRun)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: DLL side-loading is the consistent loader mechanism across Salt Typhoon's malware families: GhostEmperor's Demodex user-mode loader and FamousSparrow's SparrowDoor/Crowdoor backdoors both ship a legitimate signed binary plus a trojan DLL dropped in a non-standard, user-writable directory. Anchoring on the side-load layout (legit non-system EXE loading a co-located DLL from ProgramData/Public/Temp)
